args.title: Fix README: replace nonexistent "npm run serve" with "npm start"
args.body:
File: README.md

In the "Running locally" section, step 5 tells users to run `npm run build` followed by `npm run serve`. There is no `serve` script defined in package.json (only `start`, `build`, `test`, and `lint`), so following the README as written fails with "Missing script: serve".

Update the final command in that step from `npm run serve` to `npm start`, so the documented steps match the scripts actually available in package.json.
